claude.rationale: This is a Chapter 11 reorganization structured as a merger of the debtor subsidiary DH with and into its parent Dynegy Inc. (surviving entity), with DH ceasing separate registration (T3 N-1: two legal vehicles collapsed into one surviving entity). The generation product/assets (Roseton/Danskammer, the reacquired Coal Holdco, ~3,100 MW) and their operating processes moved together within the same corporate group, and coal-supply contracts continued flowing to Dynegy Midwest Generation as an intercompany arrangement spanning the structure — product and process were aligned coherently at closing, so gap_45=0. The operating processes and the running organization stayed within the combined Dynegy group with a creditor-selected board installed to run the surviving entity from the effective date, showing no structural process-vs-people mismatch, so gap_56=0. T1 is coded replace because old equity (DH interests and Dynegy Inc. common stock) was cancelled and creditors received the substantial majority of the reorganized company's new equity, installing new controlling ownership.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a Chapter 11 reorganization where DH merged into its parent Dynegy Inc. (T3 N-1), with creditors taking 99% of the new equity and installing a new board (T1 replace). The business operations, products, and organization transferred intact to the surviving entity without any documented structural mismatch between products and processes (gap_45 = 0) or processes and organization (gap_56 = 0).

grok.rationale: The confirmed Plan merged DH into Dynegy Inc. as Surviving Entity, with Coal Holdco reacquired and remaining generation plus the intercompany coal-supply onward-sale arrangement continuing under that single vehicle, so the customer-facing generation layer and its operating processes were not structurally separated at closing (gap_45=0). A creditor-agreed new board was installed at the Effective Date together with the 99%/1% equity allocation to claimholders, and the slice does not document processes being re-engineered or transferred without organizational/governance alignment alongside them (gap_56=0).
